description.label: Description
description.value:
Worshipper of the Hound:

-While Frenzy is activated, you can now score a Critical Hit on a tens result when using axes—10, 20, 30, 40, etc.

Warrior of the Hound:

-Gain +1 Movement while Frenzied.

-While Frenzy is activated, you ignore all your current Conditions (except for Ablaze) until Frenzy has ended, then all prior Conditions return as normal.

Champion of the Hound:

-When wielding an axe while Frenzied, the user now gains the Hack and Damaging Weapon Qualities on all one-handed axes.

-If using a two-handed Great Axe while Frenzied, it now loses the Tiring Quality for Impact.

Chosen of the Hound:

-When Frenzied, gain the Champion Trait.

-Warp Frenzy: Whilst Frenzied, you have the option to temporarily gain another random physical mutation for 1d10 minutes. Roll 1d10 on the table @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-tables.RollTable.tI1syOkdXB0Y5UOV]{Chosen of the Hound} to see your mutation. You gain 1 Corruption point if used.
